#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# run_breadth.sh — RESUMABLE driver for the MULTI-LANGUAGE breadth benchmark
# (and, via FAMILY=, the Python depth re-run). A sibling of run_g3_n4.sh: it only
# orchestrates the existing entrypoints (build/deepmap_cli.py, run_benchmark.py);
# build/retrieval.py is never touched, nothing is fabricated or published.
#
# Two modes:
#   MODE=loop  (default) — Opus anchor only, n=1, CAPTURE-ONLY (no paid judge).
#                          The fast improvement-loop pass: read the FREE completeness
#                          signal afterwards with `python benchmark/completeness_only.py <ids>`.
#   MODE=final           — Opus anchor + any $CLAUDE_MODELS, n=$RUNS (default 2), then
#                          the blind Stage-2 --score (parallel) and a --merge.
#
# SPENDS: the Claude arm(s) + (final only) the blind judge run on your Claude Code
# PLAN (~$0 out-of-pocket, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unset). No OpenRouter. Only the OPERATOR
# should launch it. Resumable: a repo whose run-id already has captures (loop) or is
# scored (final) is skipped, so a re-launch continues where it stopped.
#
# Usage:
#   export NEO4J_PASSWORD=deepmap
#   MODE=loop  bash benchmark/run_breadth.sh                      # multi-lang, Opus n=1, free signal
#   MODE=final CLAUDE_MODELS="claude-sonnet-5" bash benchmark/run_breadth.sh
#   REPOS="pallets/flask pallets/werkzeug pallets/click fastapi/fastapi" \
#     FAMILY="runtime_edge,multi_hop" RUNS=4 MODE=final PREFIX=depthn4 \
#     bash benchmark/run_breadth.sh                               # the Python DEPTH n=4 re-run
#
# Env (all optional):
#   REPOS="a/b c/d"     repos to run (default: the 4 breadth repos). Names as in repos.yaml.
#   MODE=loop|final     see above (default loop).
#   FAMILY=f1,f2        restrict to these question families (passed to run_benchmark --family).
#   RUNS=<n>            runs/arm (default: loop=1, final=2).
#   CLAUDE_MODELS="..." extra Claude arms for final mode (space-separated model ids).
#   PREFIX=<str>        run-id prefix (default: breadth). run-id = <PREFIX>-<owner__name>.
#   CLONES=<dir>        pinned-clone root (default /tmp/deepmap-bench-clones).
#   TIMEOUT_S=<sec>     per-run claude timeout (default 180; caps a hang).
#   SKIP_MCP_START=1    don't (re)start the detached MCP servers.
#   SKIP_PROBE=1        skip the pre-flight --probe (only if it already passed this session).
#   DO_CLONE=1          clone/checkout any missing repo at its pinned SHA.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"

CLONES="${CLONES:-/tmp/deepmap-bench-clones}"
RESULTS="benchmark/results"
MODE="${MODE:-loop}"
PREFIX="${PREFIX:-breadth}"
TIMEOUT_S="${TIMEOUT_S:-180}"
FAMILY="${FAMILY:-}"
CLAUDE_MODELS="${CLAUDE_MODELS:-}"
DEFAULT_BREADTH="julienschmidt/httprouter serde-rs/json gin-gonic/gin colinhacks/zod"
REPOS="${REPOS:-$DEFAULT_BREADTH}"
LOG="${DRIVER_LOG:-$RESULTS/${PREFIX}-driver.log}"
if [ "$MODE" = "final" ]; then RUNS="${RUNS:-2}"; else RUNS="${RUNS:-1}"; fi

mkdir -p "$RESULTS"
exec > >(tee -a "$LOG") 2>&1
log() { printf '[breadth %s] %s\n' "$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)" "$*"; }
die() { printf '[breadth ERROR] %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

export DEEPMAP_REAL_ENGINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export PYTHONUTF8=1
: "${NEO4J_PASSWORD:?set NEO4J_PASSWORD (dev default: deepmap)}"
command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "python not on PATH"
command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "claude (Claude Code CLI) not on PATH — the arm(s) + judge need it"
[ -f benchmark/repos.yaml ] || die "benchmark/repos.yaml missing — run from a DeepMap checkout"

sanitize() { printf '%s' "${1//\//__}"; }

# scored | captured | none  (for resume)
classify_run() {
  python - "$1" <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, sys
p = pathlib.Path("benchmark/results") / sys.argv[1] / "results.json"
if not p.is_file():
    print("none"); sys.exit(0)
try:
    print("scored" if json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("measured") else "captured")
except Exception:
    print("none")
PY
}
# has any capture been written for this run-id? (loop mode has no results.json)
has_captures() { compgen -G "$RESULTS/$1/**/record.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || find "$RESULTS/$1" -name record.json 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; }

clone_if_needed() {  # <name>
  local name="$1" san url sha dir
  san="$(sanitize "$name")"; dir="$CLONES/$san"
  [ -d "$dir/.git" ] && return 0
  [ "${DO_CLONE:-0}" = "1" ] || die "clone missing: $dir (clone it at its pinned SHA, or re-run with DO_CLONE=1)"
  read -r url sha < <(python -c "import yaml,sys
n=sys.argv[1]
for r in yaml.safe_load(open('benchmark/repos.yaml'))['repos']:
    if r['name']==n: print(r['url'], r['pinned_sha']); break" "$name" | tr -d '\r')
  [ -n "$url" ] && [ -n "$sha" ] || die "no url/pinned_sha for $name in repos.yaml"
  mkdir -p "$CLONES"; log "clone $name -> $dir @ ${sha:0:12}"
  git clone "$url" "$dir" && git -C "$dir" checkout "$sha"
}

# --- MCP servers + probe -----------------------------------------------------
if [ "${SKIP_MCP_START:-0}" != "1" ]; then log "starting detached MCP servers (idempotent)…"; python build/provision.py mcp-start; fi
if [ "${SKIP_PROBE:-0}" != "1" ]; then
  log "pre-flight --probe (ON loads / OFF isolated / capture-path)…"
  python benchmark/run_benchmark.py --probe || die "--probe failed — fix MCP wiring before the matrix"
  log "probe OK"
fi

# --- extra Claude arms (final mode) -----------------------------------------
MODEL_ARGS=(); for m in $CLAUDE_MODELS; do MODEL_ARGS+=(--claude-model "$m"); done
FAM_ARGS=(); [ -n "$FAMILY" ] && FAM_ARGS+=(--family "$FAMILY")

log "MODE=$MODE  RUNS=$RUNS  PREFIX=$PREFIX  FAMILY='${FAMILY:-*}'  arms=Opus${CLAUDE_MODELS:+ + $CLAUDE_MODELS}"
log "repos: $REPOS"

RUN_IDS=()
for name in $REPOS; do
  san="$(sanitize "$name")"; rid="${PREFIX}-$san"; dir="$CLONES/$san"
  RUN_IDS+=("$rid")
  state="$(classify_run "$rid" | tr -d '\r')"
  if [ "$MODE" = "final" ] && [ "$state" = "scored" ]; then log "SKIP $name — already scored ($rid)"; continue; fi
  if [ "$MODE" = "final" ] && [ "$state" = "captured" ]; then
    log "RESUME $name — captured; blind score only ($rid)"
    python benchmark/run_benchmark.py --score "$rid" --score-workers 6; continue
  fi
  if [ "$MODE" = "loop" ] && has_captures "$rid"; then log "SKIP $name — loop captures exist ($rid)"; continue; fi

  clone_if_needed "$name"
  log "sync $name graph at its pinned SHA…"
  python build/deepmap_cli.py sync "$dir" --switch-project --stale-cleanup 2>&1 | grep -v 'it/s\|HF_TOKEN\|Loading weights' | tail -3
  log "capture $name (n=$RUNS, MODE=$MODE)…"
  python benchmark/run_benchmark.py --repo "$name" --clone-root "$CLONES" --run-id "$rid" \
    --runs-per-arm "$RUNS" --timeout-s "$TIMEOUT_S" "${FAM_ARGS[@]}" "${MODEL_ARGS[@]}"
  if [ "$MODE" = "final" ]; then
    log "blind Stage-2 score $name…"; python benchmark/run_benchmark.py --score "$rid" --score-workers 6
    log "measured $name ($rid)"
  else
    log "captured $name ($rid) — read FREE completeness with: python benchmark/completeness_only.py $rid"
  fi
done

if [ "$MODE" = "final" ]; then
  log "merge → $RESULTS/${PREFIX}-combined/results.md"
  python benchmark/run_benchmark.py --merge "$(IFS=,; echo "${RUN_IDS[*]}")" --run-id "${PREFIX}-combined"
  log "DONE. Combined table: $RESULTS/${PREFIX}-combined/results.md"
else
  log "LOOP DONE. Free completeness across all: python benchmark/completeness_only.py ${RUN_IDS[*]}"
fi
